name: Resistance / Muscular Training
definition: Exercises using external or bodyweight resistance to develop muscular fitness.

name: Cardiorespiratory Training
definition: Continuous or intermittent work primarily targeting cardiorespiratory fitness.

name: Power / Explosive Training
definition: Training emphasizing force production at high movement velocity.

name: Plyometric Training
definition: Explosive stretch-shortening-cycle jumps, hops, bounds, and throws.

name: Speed / Sprint Training
definition: Training to improve acceleration and maximal movement speed.

name: Agility / Change-of-Direction
definition: Planned or reactive acceleration, deceleration, and direction change.

name: Mobility Training
definition: Active movement through usable ranges of motion.

name: Flexibility / Stretching
definition: Training designed to maintain or increase passive/active range of motion.

name: Balance / Proprioception
definition: Training postural control and stability.

name: Core / Trunk Training
definition: Training trunk force production, transfer, and stability.

name: Functional / Integrated Training
definition: Multi-joint or task-oriented movement integrating multiple regions.

name: Metabolic Conditioning
definition: Mixed exercise arranged to challenge work capacity and energy systems.

name: Recovery / Regeneration
definition: Low-intensity activity, mobility, and tissue-care sessions supporting recovery.

name: Sport-Specific Training
definition: Training designed around demands of a particular sport.

name: Fitness Testing / Assessment
definition: Structured tests used to establish baselines and monitor progress.

name: General Fitness
definition: Improve broad physical capacity and consistency.

name: General Strength
definition: Increase force production across common movement patterns.

name: Maximal Strength
definition: Increase the highest force that can be produced in a movement.

name: Muscle Hypertrophy
definition: Increase skeletal-muscle size.

name: Muscular Endurance
definition: Sustain repeated muscular contractions or submaximal work.

name: Muscular Power
definition: Produce force rapidly.

name: Power Endurance
definition: Repeat high-power efforts with limited performance drop.

name: Strength Endurance
definition: Maintain force output over repeated efforts.

name: Aerobic Base
definition: Improve low-to-moderate intensity aerobic capacity.

name: VO2max / High Aerobic Capacity
definition: Improve maximal aerobic power.

name: Threshold Performance
definition: Improve sustainable high-aerobic intensity.

name: Anaerobic Capacity
definition: Improve tolerance and output during intense short-duration work.

name: Speed
definition: Improve acceleration or maximal sprint speed.

name: Agility / COD
definition: Improve acceleration, braking, direction change, and reactive movement.

name: Mobility
definition: Improve active control through useful joint ranges.

name: Flexibility
definition: Increase or maintain range of motion.

name: Balance
definition: Improve postural control and proprioception.

name: Body Composition Support
definition: Support energy expenditure and lean-mass retention/gain through exercise.

name: Sport Performance
definition: Improve capacities relevant to a chosen sport.

name: Technique / Skill
definition: Improve movement quality and technical efficiency.

name: Recovery
definition: Promote low-stress movement and readiness between harder sessions.

action: Exclude advanced training methods unless manually approved.
Do not auto-prescribe; require qualified review.
AI cannot select automatically; manual approval required.
Prefer lower setup complexity and supersets where compatible.
Prefer exercises with easy substitutions and minimal station monopolization.
Prefer fatigue_cost_1_5 <= 3; reduce volume/intensity within programmed bounds.
Cover requested push/pull patterns without unnecessary duplication.
Match movement pattern + primary muscle + goal + difficulty before equipment similarity.
Avoid redundant variants from the same exercise family unless intentionally programmed.
Preserve prescribed values separately from performed values.
